body:
Shakira's October 3 Madrid concert became Amazon Music's most-viewed livestream by a female artist, with Dua Lipa joining her for a surprise acoustic performance of "Antología." Amazon announced the record the following day but did not publish a viewer total.

The show streamed worldwide through Amazon Music, Prime Video and Twitch, making it Shakira's first full-concert global livestream. It also served as the centerpiece of Amazon Music's 2026 Women Shaping Latin Music campaign.

The concert took place at Shakira Stadium, the temporary venue built inside Madrid's Iberdrola Music complex for the residency. Dua joined Shakira for "Antología," the ballad from *Pies Descalzos*, released in 1995. Dua had performed the song on her own in Bogotá in 2025, but Madrid marked the first time the two sang it together.

The Madrid setup was designed as more than a standard tour stop. Around the temporary stadium, organizers created Macondo Park, with exhibitions, workshops and other programming centered on Latin culture. The October 3 broadcast brought one of those residency nights to viewers far beyond the venue itself without changing the scope of Amazon's claim. The record applies specifically to female artists livestreamed on Amazon Music.

The residency was originally announced as three shows and kept expanding as demand grew. Shakira will close the Madrid run with one final concert on October 12.
